\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{মালপত্র} (mālpôtrô)}{মালপত্র (mālpôtrô)}]{\bn{মালপত্র} (mālpôtrô) — luggage}

\label{lesson:BN-C163-malpotro}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for whole, then the Bengali for slight.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{মালপত্র}}
\textbf{\bn{মালপত্র}} — \emph{mālpôtrô} — \textquotedblleft{}luggage\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{মালপত্র}} (\emph{mālpôtrô}) is \emph{māl}, \textquotedblleft{}goods\textquotedblright{}, from Arabic \emph{māl}, \textquotedblleft{}property\textquotedblright{}, which reached Bengali through Persian (Lane), + \emph{pôtrô}, Sanskrit \emph{pattra}, \textquotedblleft{}leaf, letter\textquotedblright{}, here meaning \textquotedblleft{}and such things\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
